test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Two Statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All bowls are spoons.

All spoons are plates.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some plates are bowls.

II. Some plates are spoons.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn Diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15b95bb70431ff9ffa052f7aa1823f7c15b34c1785b795d10cd96c3adbcee8b2.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some plates are bowls. → Follows (because all bowls are spoons and all spoons are plates, so we can say that some plates are definitely bowls.)

II. Some plates are spoons. → Follows (because all bowls are spoons and all spoons are plates, so we can say that some plates are definitely spoons.) 

Hence, “Both conclusions I and II follow.”.
